local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local points={{util.vector3(3603.7,10369.5,-1440),util.vector3(3988.6,10366.7,-1440),util.vector3(4104.5,10363.8,-1440),util.vector3(4102.1,10123.6,-1440),util.vector3(4092.4,9863.1,-1440),util.vector3(4109.3,9732,-1440),util.vector3(4101.8,9478.6,-1440),util.vector3(4438,9350.4,-1440),util.vector3(4653.9,9346.8,-1440),util.vector3(4890.9,9343.3,-1440),util.vector3(5011.9,9344.1,-1440)}}
local step=1
local frames=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if self.cell and self.cell.id==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x272f2) then print('Player entered Imperial Sewers03') return end
 frames=frames+1
 for _,row in ipairs({{{{0x2282e,'Sewer key door'}},{{0x270e2,'Sewer manhole'}}}}) do
  local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',row[1]))
  if obj and obj:isValid() then
   local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(obj.position)
   local yaw=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z)
   local pitch=-math.atan2(v.y,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.z*v.z))
   print(string.format('%s aim x=%d y=%d',row[2],math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(yaw*5120+.5))),math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(pitch*5120+.5)))))
  end
 end
 if frames%5==0 then print('Sanctum departure pos '..tostring(self.position)..' yaw='..camera.getYaw()) end
 assert(Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current>0,'Player died on Sanctum departure')
 if frames==5 then print('Sanctum departure ready') end
 if step<=#points then
  local d=points[step]-self.position
  if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<25 then
   print('Sanctum departure waypoint '..step..' reached') step=step+1
  else
   local c=camera.getPosition()
   local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(util.vector3(c.x+d.x,c.y+d.y,c.z))
   local angle=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z)
   print(string.format('Sanctum departure waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',step,math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(angle*5120+.5))),math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*5120+.5)))
  end
 end
end}}}}
